comparison.AT-ops-49: The three equality-threshold fixtures test 59.9/69.9 eligibility, five-hour equality pause, and weekly equality pause while preserving foreground acceptance.
comparison.AT-ops-51: The eight-reservation and restart/ninth-send phases use public reserve/claim/settle/inspect, check null usage and charged reservations, then check the daily ceiling and foreground exemption. finish() settles with nativeTerminalAcknowledged=false and null usage and verifies the charge remains while reconciliation is pending.
comparison.AT-ops-52: The four veto phases cover weekly-only, reversed array order, five-hour-only, and unavailable observation with a fresh known weekly veto. The reversed-array fixture uses the normal primary=300-minute and secondary=10080-minute metadata unchanged; it does not swap duration metadata across bucket IDs.
comparison.policy: ModelAdmissionPolicy groups windows by durationMinutes (300 and 10080), applies fresh known threshold vetoes before fixed-count fallback, and does not use array position or bucketId to select threshold type. No current policy defect was established by this read-only comparison.

selectedGap.behavior: Explicitly prove that swapping 300-minute and 10080-minute metadata across the primary/secondary bucket IDs cannot hide the threshold associated with the actual duration.

minimumPublicChange.edit: Extend the existing fresh-known-veto-1 mandatory phase with swapped-duration metadata observations whose used percentages distinguish duration-based interpretation from bucket-ID-based interpretation. Assert the veto reason follows duration metadata. Keep the existing reversed-array-order vector and aggregate the added observations in this same phase so no mandatory-case registry change is needed.

minimumPublicChange.expectedRed: A policy mutant that binds thresholds to primary/secondary bucket IDs or array position will accept a crafted swapped-metadata case or return the wrong named-window threshold.
minimumPublicChange.expectedGreen: The real public ModelAdmission reserve decision vetoes based on durationMinutes under the swapped mapping, with the expected five-hour or weekly threshold reason.

notSelected.distinctCancellation: The assigned public ModelAdmission interface has reserve, claimSend, settle, observe, and inspect, with no separate cancel operation or cancelled record state. A new cancellation state/operation would broaden the contract beyond the smallest remaining gap.
